title: Graph Memory for LLM Agents: At What Cost? A Comparative Evaluation of Query, Ingest, and Update Performance Across Graph Database Engines
abstract: arXiv:2609.23315v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Graph databases are frequently positioned as categorically necessary for connected-data workloads, yet the systems dimension along which they actually differ - query planning, indexing, and data-readiness cost - is rarely isolated from vendor framing. We construct a synthetic, biomedical-shaped property graph (1.02 million nodes, 5.34 million total node and edge rows) and a twenty-query workload spanning neighborhood lookups, bounded paths, set intersections, anti-joins, grouped aggregation, top-k ranking, temporal filters, full scans, and relational joins. We benchmark Corvic AI - a purpose-built columnar query engine underlying Corvic's ontology management layer ("memories")- against seven purpose-built or graph-extension database systems (LoraDB, Ladybug, DuckPGQ, Memgraph, Neo4j, HugeGraph, and FalkorDB) at three graph scales spanning three orders of magnitude. We report query latency geomeans, bulk-ingest throughput, point-update

translated_title: 面向LLM智能体的图记忆：代价几何？跨图数据库引擎的查询、摄取与更新性能对比评估
translated_abstract: 图数据库经常被定位为连接数据工作负载的必要之选，但它们真正产生差异的系统维度——查询规划、索引以及数据就绪成本——却很少与厂商的营销宣传区分开来。我们构建了一个合成的、生物医学形态的属性图（102万个节点，节点与边总计534万行数据），以及一个包含二十个查询的工作负载，涵盖邻域查找、有界路径、集合交集、反连接、分组聚合、top-k排名、时间过滤、全表扫描和关系连接等操作。我们将Corvic AI——Corvic本体管理层（即“记忆”）底层的专用列式查询引擎——与七个专用图数据库或图扩展数据库系统（LoraDB、Ladybug、DuckPGQ、Memgraph、Neo4j、HugeGraph和FalkorDB）在跨越三个数量级的三个图规模下进行基准测试。我们报告了查询延迟几何平均值、批量摄取吞吐量、点更新（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文构建了一个生物医学形态的合成属性图和二十种查询负载，将Corvic AI列式查询引擎与七个图数据库系统在跨越三个数量级的规模下对比查询延迟、批量摄取吞吐量和点更新性能，从而剥离厂商宣传、揭示各引擎的真实系统能力差异。
en_tdlr: The paper benchmarks Corvic AI's columnar query engine against seven graph database systems on a synthetic biomedical property graph across three orders of magnitude in scale, evaluating query latency, bulk-ingest throughput, and point-update performance to isolate real system differences from vendor claims.
